View images belong to the selected Images product and option above — never to a 3D-model product. Each view keeps its own human name (for example “Crown”); names never change measurements. A replacement starts unmeasured: its photo mapping retires while other views, logos and measurements are kept.

Save a prepared master (advanced reuse)

Downloads the current source package byte-identical, for reuse as prepared input. Reopen it with “Open an existing project”. Anchors authored in Set up product and staged photo mappings travel with the master.
